title: 80% of People Have 'Laundry Anxiety'
paragraphs: Whites in one pile, colors in another. But wait — what temperature do these clothes need to be washed at? Can sheets and jeans be washed together?
For some people, doing laundry is a normal part of adult life. But according to a new survey, it makes many people anxious!
The survey was done by Samsung with 2,000 adults in the UK.
It found that 80% of people have felt anxiety while doing laundry. About half said they're afraid to wash certain clothes because they don't want to ruin them.
In fact, only 15% feel confident washing different types of clothes! People are most likely to avoid washing woolens, embellished clothes, coats and cashmere in the washing machine.
Others worry about how to wash vintage clothing — with 10% saying this has stopped them from buying vintage clothes altogether!
On average, each person has four items of clothing they feel anxious about washing.
Some people also said they're not sure how to wash jeans, with many saying they hand-wash them instead of using the washing machine.
So why are people so anxious?
A little over half of participants said they've ruined something in the wash. Clothes getting smaller or losing their color were the most common problems.
Almost two-thirds said that ruining something in the wash made them more anxious about washing other clothes.
But while many have laundry anxiety, others are the opposite. The survey found that 12% of people put most clothes in the washing machine without worrying about what will happen to them.
